scripts.build:all: npm run build:cli && npm run build
scripts.build:cli:dev: cargo build --manifest-path windsurf_chat/Cargo.toml && mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries && cp windsurf_chat/target/debug/windsurf_chat src-tauri/binaries/windsurf_chat
scripts.tauri:build: npm run build:cli && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin
scripts.tauri:build:intel: npm run build:cli && tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.tauri:build:arm: npm run build:cli && tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.tauri:build:fast: npm run build:cli && CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=thin CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=16 CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_OPT_LEVEL=2 tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin
scripts.tauri:build:fast:arm: npm run build:cli && CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=thin CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=16 CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_OPT_LEVEL=2 tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
